systems.system: Education Management Information System (EMIS), producing the annual Education Statistical Bulletins from the school census
systems.country_label: EMIS; Education Statistical Bulletin; school census
systems.tiers: Registered public and private schools submit data, some late and some not at all; bulletins cover ECCD, primary, secondary, TVET, non-formal and tertiary; last bulletin 2019, with 2020 and 2021 not produced

systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Training, with a Community Systems Foundation mission scheduled for November 2022
systems.tiers: Not in use at the date of the report: the mission was expected to upgrade the system to an Open EMIS

note: No fact: the panel (February 2023) says the EMIS is paper-based, produces annual bulletins from school returns, and 'does not collect and track data' for individual schools, learners and teachers, so it is class census. That is a statement about the ministry's system, not about how schools keep their own learner records. Open EMIS is named as a coming upgrade with no account of what schools would enter.
